page_title: NAN 0-2 HAV | Nantes v Le Havre 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+38' The corner is swung in but Nantes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+35' Substitution. Gautier Lloris will be replaced by Loic Nego (Le Havre).
90+35' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
90+34' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Yassine Kechta will be replaced by Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre).
90+1' The game is interrupted.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
87' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
85' Here is a change. Johann Lepenant is going off and Antoine Kombouare gives the last tactical orders to Dehmaine Assoumani (Nantes).
85' Moses Simon goes off the pitch and Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) comes on.
84' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Johann Lepenant (Nantes) commits a foul after dangerous play.

82' What a sweet touch by Johann Lepenant (Nantes) as he runs onto a pass deep into the box and fires a fine shot to the right side of the net. The keeper makes a superb save and pushes the ball against the post.

79' Nathan Zeze (Nantes) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
78' Moses Simon (Nantes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

78' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Nantes will take a corner kick.
74' 0 - 2 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Fabien Centonze (Nantes), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the bottom left corner of his own goal.
72' Arthur Desmas (Le Havre) is booked by the referee.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andre Ayew leaves the pitch and Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) comes on.
70' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

70' Moses Simon (Nantes) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Arthur Desmas is well positioned to make a comfortable save. The referee signals a corner kick to Nantes.
68' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pedro Chirivella.
67' Flag goes up against Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
62' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Moses Simon (Nantes) for a tough tackle.
61' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Emmanuel Sabbi is replaced by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre).
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nantes comes to nothing.
59' Nantes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' Substitution. Jean-Kevin Duverne walks off the pitch and Fabien Centonze (Nantes) comes on as a substitute.
58' Antoine Kombouare has decided to substitute Florent Mollet and he is replaced by Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes).
55' The resulting corner from Christopher Operi (Le Havre) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

55' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the right post, but Alban Lafont pulls off a decent save to thwart him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Le Havre will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
53' A lofted pass to the edge of the six-yard box is won in the air by Issa Soumare (Le Havre), but his tame header goes well wide of the left post.
50' Moses Simon (Nantes) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
47' The corner is swung in but Nantes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+7' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle as Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) was too aggressive in his challenge.
45+1' Nantes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' Matthis Abline (Nantes) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Arthur Desmas makes a comfortable save.
43' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) commits a rough foul. Jerome Brisard stops the game and makes a call.
40' Nantes fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
38' A sweet pass inside the box gives Florent Mollet (Nantes) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
36' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Matthis Abline (Nantes) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
30' Matthis Abline (Nantes) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
29' The match can continue after the interruption.
26' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
23' The resulting set piece from Nantes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
21' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Le Havre.
17' A pass lands at the feet of Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Le Havre have a corner.
16' Nantes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
14' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) makes a strong challenge and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
11' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
8' Jerome Brisard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) and blew his whistle.
8' Great teamplay by Nantes as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' 0 - 1 Goal! Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 0:1.
3' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
3' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
2' Jerome Brisard blows for a foul after Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Le Havre will kick the game off.
Jerome Brisard got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
